production_review.limits: No compile or runtime claim by this reviewer. Production length handling and deterministic FieldIO preconditions are source-coherent; this does not claim all malformed file/API cases or all later NetCDF errors are side-effect-free.
observations: GetDim rejects a nonblank suffix exceeding its three-character canonical buffer before case conversion. Trailing blank padding remains accepted; direct leading blank rejection is preserved.
LowerCase/UpperCase return blank for a nonblank input exceeding output capacity, otherwise bound copy/iteration by both declared lengths. This avoids silent truncation of xyzq and padded zz overrun.
Public read/write preserve TRIM(ADJUSTL(input)) compatibility but reject overlength normalized tokens before CHARACTER(3) assignment.

reorder now safely rejects token length outside 1:3 before substring loops; valid public permutations and ZZ identity remain unchanged. Invalid repeated three-character tokens remain a separate inherited limitation.

get_var_info checks attribute length 1:3 before reading into a blank-initialized local CHARACTER(3), validates rank there, rejects a too-short caller output, and copies to a blank-padded caller buffer. Existing writer format is three-character MemoryOrder.

FieldIO checks order, supported field type and all active dimension lengths before GetTimeIndex; scalar NDim=0 retains the empty length-section behavior. Later handle/date/NetCDF failures are not claimed transactional.
module_io NetCDF wrapper now passes a local NetCDFFieldType as eighth argument and Status as ninth without changing public wrapper arguments or other package branches.

blockers.evidence: check_varinfo_buffers is defined but no CALL occurs in the reviewed bytes. It contains wrapper/padded output/short output/public-read suffix checks and prints VARINFO_WRAPPER_CONTRACT_PASS.
blockers.consequence: The Python runner requires this marker and cannot record a passing fixture from these bytes. Its selected_varinfo_wrapper_executed=true and output-length claims cannot be established without actually executing that subroutine.
blockers.minimal_remedy: Call check_varinfo_buffers while h is still open for read, before ext_ncd_ioclose(h,...). Preserve any already-started attempt and failures; source correction needs new execution/source pins.

inherited_limits.evidence: Direct reorder(xxx,...) has N=3 and equal characters, leaving i1=i3=1 so i2=4 and subsequently reading input(4:4). The new length guard alone does not validate axis tokens.
inherited_limits.normal_public_scope: Public write calls GetDim first, which rejects xxx; no normal public regression is inferred.
inherited_limits.possible_followup: If full direct-reorder invalid-token safety is intended, validate supported order before permutation rather than describe length guard as full token validation.

fixture_source_coverage.normal_data_path: Existing integer/real/double 3x5 two-Time write/reopen/read with uppercase/lowercase and public leading/trailing blank padding retained
